statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-41568 (GHSA-vp62-88p7-qqf5, GO-2026-5668): during docker cp, the Docker daemon resolved a volume mount destination inside the container and then created the mountpoint with calls that follow symlinks, so a malicious container could swap in a symlink and make the daemon create empty files or directories at arbitrary host paths. The Go vulnerability database names Daemon.createIfNotExists and Daemon.openContainerFS in the daemon package of github.com/docker/docker, github.com/moby/moby and github.com/moby/moby/v2 as the vulnerable functions; it is fixed in Docker Engine 29.5.1 and github.com/moby/moby/v2 2.0.0-beta.14, and the fix changes daemon/containerfs_linux.go: https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-vp62-88p7-qqf5, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5668, https://github.com/moby/moby/commit/af1613468c1023941f3d701344ee1df376ba9f8a This package is the Buildx CLI plugin, a client of the Docker Engine API. Read every published docker-cli-buildx package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository (none is in the DHI Alpine security repository): 0.33.0-r1 to the current 0.39.1-r1, 29 builds for aarch64 and 28 for x86_64 (0.34.1-r0 was published for aarch64 only), each verified against the checksum in the package index. Each package installs one file, /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx, a Go program: up to 0.39.0-r0 it is a position-independent executable dynamically linked against musl with no symbol table, and in 0.39.1-r0 and 0.39.1-r1 it is a statically linked executable that keeps its symbol table. Its functions were read from each binary's Go function table (pclntab), which lists runtime.main in every binary, with vendored package paths normalised, and every binary was also searched as raw bytes for the package paths and function names. The Go build information of every build lists github.com/docker/docker v28.5.2+incompatible, together with the separate github.com/moby/moby/api and github.com/moby/moby/client modules; none lists github.com/moby/moby or github.com/moby/moby/v2. The only github.com/docker/docker package with functions in any binary is github.com/docker/docker/pkg/namesgenerator; the program reaches the Docker Engine through the github.com/moby/moby/client and github.com/moby/moby/api packages, which send API requests. No binary in any build has a function from the daemon package of github.com/docker/docker, github.com/moby/moby or github.com/moby/moby/v2, and none contains those package paths or the names openContainerFS or createIfNotExists as raw bytes, so the vulnerable daemon code is not present. As a positive control, the same function-table reader finds github.com/moby/moby/v2/daemon.(*Daemon).openContainerFS, and the same byte search finds the daemon package path and both function names, in /usr/bin/dockerd of the DHI docker-engine 29.10.0-r0 package for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64.

CVE-2026-41568 (GHSA-vp62-88p7-qqf5, GO-2026-5668): in the Docker Engine daemon before 29.5.1 (github.com/docker/docker 28.5.2 and earlier, moby/moby v2 before 2.0.0-beta.14), a race during docker cp mount setup lets a malicious container create empty files or directories at arbitrary absolute paths on the host. It is fixed in Docker Engine 29.5.1: https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-vp62-88p7-qqf5, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5668. This package contains no Go program. Unpacked every published docker-dind-dev package for Alpine 3.24 (29.7.2-r0 to 29.10.0-r3, 59 builds each for x86_64 and aarch64), every download checked against the index checksum: the payload of each is the three shell scripts docker-entrypoint.sh, dockerd-entrypoint.sh and modprobe (29.7.2-r1 ships modprobe as /usr/lib/docker-dind/modprobe.sh), plus, from 29.9.2-r9, an SPDX document, opt/docker/sbom/docker-dind-runtime/.spdx.docker-dind-runtime.json, describing the docker, dockerd, docker-proxy, containerd, ctr, containerd-shim-runc-v2, runc and docker-buildx programs of the separate packages it depends on. That document lists github.com/docker/docker 28.5.2 as modules of those programs, but it is a JSON text file, not code. No build contains an ELF, PE or Mach-O file, a static archive or any other compiled program. github.com/docker/docker reaches an image only inside those separately packaged programs, which are assessed as their own owners.

CVE-2026-41568 (GO-2026-5668, GHSA-vp62-88p7-qqf5): a race in the Docker daemon's docker cp mount setup lets a malicious container create empty files or directories at arbitrary host paths. The Go vulnerability database names Daemon.createIfNotExists and Daemon.openContainerFS in the daemon package of github.com/docker/docker, github.com/moby/moby and github.com/moby/moby/v2 as the vulnerable functions, and describes them as daemon-owned, Linux-specific code not intended for use as a Go library; only github.com/moby/moby/v2 has a fixed release (2.0.0-beta.14): https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-vp62-88p7-qqf5, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5668. We read every published trivy-dev package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 38 builds, 0.69.1-r0 to the current 0.74.0-r12, each for x86_64 and aarch64, each verified against the checksum in the package index. Each package installs one file, /usr/bin/trivy, a Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0 that keeps its symbol table; we read its Go build information, its function table (which lists runtime.main in every binary) and its raw bytes. The build information lists github.com/docker/docker v28.5.2+incompatible in 0.69.1-r0 to 0.69.3-r7 and does not list it from 0.70.0-r0; no build lists github.com/moby/moby or github.com/moby/moby/v2. No build has a function from the daemon package of github.com/docker/docker, github.com/moby/moby or github.com/moby/moby/v2 in its function table, and none contains any of those daemon package paths or the names createIfNotExists or openContainerFS in its bytes, so the vulnerable daemon code is not present. As a positive control, the same function-table read and byte search find github.com/moby/moby/v2/daemon.(*Daemon).openContainerFS and github.com/moby/moby/v2/daemon.createIfNotExists in /usr/bin/dockerd from the DHI docker-engine 29.4.0-r1 package for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64, which is built from Docker 29.4.0, a release without the fix.

CVE-2026-41568 (GHSA-vp62-88p7-qqf5, GO-2026-5668): a race in the Docker daemon's handling of `docker cp` lets a malicious container swap a volume mount destination for a symlink and create empty files or directories at arbitrary host paths. The vulnerable code is Daemon.createIfNotExists and Daemon.openContainerFS in the daemon package (github.com/docker/docker/daemon, github.com/moby/moby/daemon and github.com/moby/moby/v2/daemon), which the advisory describes as daemon-owned code not intended for use as a Go library: https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-vp62-88p7-qqf5, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5668. We read every published alloy-dev package for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository: 44 versions, 1.18.1-0 to the current 1.22.0-16, for amd64 and arm64 (1.21.2-0 is published for arm64 only), 87 packages in all, after verifying each download against its index SHA256; no debug-symbol packages are published for this source. The Go program in each is /usr/bin/alloy. Its build information records github.com/docker/docker 28.5.2+incompatible, together with github.com/moby/moby/api v1.55.0 and github.com/moby/moby/client v0.5.0 or v0.5.1, in 1.18.1-0 to 1.19.2-7; from 1.20.1-0 on it records github.com/moby/moby/api v1.56.0 and github.com/moby/moby/client v0.6.0 and no github.com/docker/docker, and no build records github.com/moby/moby or github.com/moby/moby/v2. Alloy uses these modules as a client of the Docker API. We read the function table (pclntab) of /usr/bin/alloy and searched its strings in every package: each contains runtime.main, and none contains a function from any of the three daemon packages or the names createIfNotExists or openContainerFS. As a check, the same function-table reader lists Daemon.openContainerFS, and the same strings search finds both names, in the dockerd program of the DHI docker-engine 29.10.0-r1 package for Alpine 3.23, x86_64 and aarch64. The vulnerable daemon code is not compiled into this package.

Its build information records github.com/docker/docker 28.5.2+incompatible, together with github.com/moby/moby/api v1.55.0 and github.com/moby/moby/client v0.5.0 or v0.5.1, in 1.18.1-0 to 1.19.2-7; from 1.20.1-0 on it records github.com/moby/moby/api v1.56.0 and github.com/moby/moby/client v0.6.0 and no github.com/docker/docker, and no build records github.com/moby/moby or github.com/moby/moby/v2. Alloy uses these modules as a client of the Docker API. We read the function table (pclntab) of /usr/bin/alloy and searched its strings in every package: each contains runtime.main, and none contains a function from any of the three daemon packages or the names createIfNotExists or openContainerFS. As a check, the same function-table reader lists Daemon.openContainerFS, and the same strings search finds both names, in the dockerd program of the DHI docker-engine 29.10.0-r1 package for Alpine 3.23, x86_64 and aarch64. The vulnerable daemon code is not compiled into this package.
